scope: Explicit acknowledgment of completed provisioning only. No incomplete-provisioning replay, reattachment, storage reclamation or host-reboot qualification.

invariants.operation: Exact original prepare-operation UUID, engine, project and configured root; actual completed manifest and retained reservation must agree.
invariants.liveOwner: Nonblocking registry-directory flock excludes current provisioning and reconciliation processes. Durable fence survives process exit. One worker version per selected engine is required.
invariants.acknowledgment: Append and sync one private acknowledgment before removing only its matching fence. A lost acknowledgment can be inspected again without replaying provisioning.
invariants.refusal: Incomplete or changed storage, changed acknowledgment, active owner, wrong project/operation, foreign fence or insufficient headroom retain existing records.
invariants.retention: No format, mount, recreation, delete or reservation release. Reconciliation grants no execution permission.
